page.overview:
Who is Coram II?

Coram II was the fourth known king of Cintra and the son of King Coram I and Queen Rigoberta. In , when he was 22 years old, he married Fiona of Temeria, one of the Houtborg triplets, and they had a son, Corbett.

He didn't take over the throne until , when he was 35 and his father passed away. However, he didn't rule for long as he himself died at 42 years old from injuries during a knight tournament, or so some claim. It was known, however, that he loved tournaments and tried to participate in them in any possible way, though he had rather poor health and wasn't very capable of chivalrous feats.
